mainEntity.name: Copyfy or AdSpy: which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: product research, store analysis, product pages and going live on Shopify. AdSpy is better if you only want to comb through Facebook and Instagram ads. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for pure ad monitoring, AdSpy stays solid.
No, AdSpy is more expensive: 149$/month against 49€/month for Copyfy, and for a narrower scope limited to Facebook and Instagram ad spying. The Copyfy trial lasts 5 days and needs no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which has the better product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, without hesitation. Its AI targets winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores, whereas AdSpy only infers trends from ads. To move fast toward a product to launch, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, product pages and Shopify integration. AdSpy keeps the edge on the depth of its Facebook and Instagram ad database: if intensive ad spying is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Does AdSpy offer a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, AdSpy offers no free trial: you have to pay 149$/month to access the tool. Copyfy, on the other hand, offers a 5-day free trial with no credit card. The simplest path is to test Copyfy for free to see whether the suite covers your need.
